summary: Per-frame AI tick for one vehicle. Early-reject when AIControlFlag at this+0x32C8 exceeds 1. Two major branches: (a) pre-race / session-phase path gated on the base object's slot-live marker and this+0x45F4 flag that runs countdown and grid-lights logic and writes control outputs; (b) the normal racing path that computes heading from yaw, runs pit scheduling, ability cadence, proximity scans, racing-line, steering, gearshift, and a driverStatus state machine (0,1,2,3,6,7) plus pit/terminal handling for status 4/5.

operations.description: Entry gate: if AIControlFlag at this+0x32C8 > 1, return immediately (tick disabled for locked/retired slots).
Snapshot AIControlFlag byte (this+0x45F4) into v2 and stamp this+0x4480 with current time dbl_8AFEA0 (per-frame time base).
Pre-race init path gate: AIControlFlag==0 and base-object marker obj+0x32C8==1 (reached by dereferencing this+0).
Read stored session phase (this+0x444C) into v3; zero AIInternalCounter (this+0x4028) and throttle output (this+0x4434).
Phase-change detect: global session phase dword_7C56A8 differs from stored this+0x444C.
Decrement phase-transition countdown this+0x4448 by 0.025 per frame.
Countdown elapsed once this+0x4448 drops below 0.
AIRingBufferFieldInit(this): reset the AI ring-buffer history on phase transition.
Session phase 5 or 1: call SessionCleanupFlagClear(this) before re-storing the phase.
Store the current phase global dword_7C56A8 back into this+0x444C.
Pit-schedule loop gate: AIControlFlag byte ==1 and global byte_5C3160 ==1.
Arm PitDecisionTimer this+0x413C = dbl_8AFEA0 + 2.0.
5-iteration pass over pit-schedule entries beginning at this+0x4144 (adjacent dword pairs read via v6).
Per entry: [1]==4 with [0]==0 selects the plan-write path; else [1]==5 with [0]==0 selects the rejoin-decision path.
ConditionalGate(this+12) invoked on both pit-schedule branches.
RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator()%4 mapped to finish reason 7/3/8; write ReasonCode this+0x4068 only if currently 0.
(rand & 0x14) + dbl_8AFEA0 + 10.0 written to this+0x4170 (next pit-timing deadline).
Race-start phase branch: stored session phase this+0x444C == 4.
Set global byte_5C3160 = 1 and call RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate(0).
dt = dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_8ACFB8 (time since lights stage start).
Hold branch when dt <= 0.2 and, inside it, lap-timing path while dbl_8AFEA0 < this+0x4564.
Lights ramp factor v17 = clamp(now - this+0x4560, 0..1) scaled by -25 (countdown throttle pull).
Pick throttle-output table entry via CRTFtol(v18) from unk_5C30E0 or dword_5C3144 depending on flag this+0x4568; write this+0x4434, brake=1.0 (this+0x4438), steer=0 (this+0x442C).
Randomize lights timing: flip flag this+0x4568, stamp this+0x4560 = now, schedule this+0x4564 = now + 1.0 or now + (rand()%100)*0.01/0.02.
Post-lights throttle ramp: v16 = 1250 - (dt-0.2)*0.5556 or 250; throttle output this+0x4434 = (this+0x399C - this+0x39A0)/v16 + 0.5.
Clamp low: throttle this+0x4434 < 0 forces 0, brake=1.0, steer=0, then jumps to the shared output path.
Clamp high: throttle this+0x4434 > 1 forces 1.0, brake=1.0, steer=0, then shared output path.
Shared output path LABEL_86: carConditions this+0x3D6C == 2 (special fuel/conditions brake handling).
Emit control outputs: steering this+0x3580 = steer command, brake this+0x3584 = brake command, throttle this+0x357C = throttle command; clear this+0x45FC = 0.
Early return after pre-race control outputs are written.
Normal racing path: heading vector this+0x448C = -sin(yaw), this+0x4494 = -cos(yaw), with yaw from RenderX this+0x34F0.
Return unless sub_426430(this) is truthy and the base-object marker obj+0x32C8 == 1 (activity/objectivity gate).
Pit-decision due: dbl_8AFEA0 > PitDecisionTimer this+0x413C.
Disarm timer: this+0x413C = 0x7F800000 (float +inf sentinel).
Session phase 8 -> AIStateFlagSetter(1); otherwise AIPushLap(this) (lap-push or state-flag set depending on phase).
5-iteration pass over waypoint-queue entries from this+0x4170 region (v22); entry guarded by lapNumber this+0x403C == entry lap and entry count < 4.
Lap-time slot: copy bestLap this+0x409C into this+0x416C, floored at 40.0 (literal 1109393408).
rand() % CRTFtol(this+0x416C) stored into this+0x416C and into a per-entry array slot selected by the entry index (constant base not present in field list).
Ability cadence: this+0x4480 (current time) > this+0x4404 (last ability time).
this+0x4404 = this+0x4480 + 4.0; call AIAbility(this).
Pit-trigger: this+0x4170 (next pit check) < this+0x4480 (current time).

Pit entry: zero this+0x443C and this+0x43F8; AIClearStateFlags(this); driverStatus this+0x4510 = 4 when phase-global dword_7C56A4 == 7 else 5; zero this+0x4524; brake=1.0 (this+0x4438); throttle 0 (this+0x4434); CallToBox this+0x454C = 0; WaypointSetSelector this+0x4550 = 1; this+0x4424 = 0; sub_426430(this); this+0x4170 = +inf sentinel; this+0x447C = dbl_8AFEA0 + 4.0; VehicleClimbAdjust(0).
Normal driving branch: driverStatus this+0x4510 is neither 4 nor 5.
Throttle-free gate: this+0x45FC == 0 and carConditions != 2 and FuelLevel this+0x3984 > 0.001 -> this+0x4420 = 0.
OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition(this): team/battle proximity scan.
Seed this+0x4484 = 1232348144 (999999.0, race-pace reset marker).
AIRacingLine(this): racing-line selection.
AISteering(this) only when WaypointSetSelector this+0x4550 < dword_5EA2CC.
Chained control logic: sub_426100(this); AISteeringCorrection(this); PhysicsGearShiftLogicWithThresholds(this).
Switch on driverStatus this+0x4510: case 0/6 SteeringAngleController(this); case 1 sub_4258C0(this); case 2 FieldZeroSetter(this) then return; case 7 terminal-stop; case 3 waypoint-radius handling.

Case 3: ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy(dword_5EA2C0, obj+0x48A4, out) -> squared distance from copied waypoint (Z and X against this+0x34E8/0x34E0); if > this+0x461C set driverStatus=0, else shrink this+0x461C to the distance.
Case 7: zero steer/brake/throttle commands (this+0x442C=0, this+0x4438=1.0, this+0x4434=0); if Speed this+0x4440 < 0.2 set driverStatus=0.
Pit/terminal branch: dbl_8AFEA0 > timeOfNextExit this+0x4534 or driverStatus == 4 (held in pit lane).
Exit criteria: this+0x45E0 >= this+0x4588 and phase-global dword_7C56A4 != 7 -> AIControlFlag=0; FinishState this+0x4064 == 2 -> AIControlFlag=0.
Rejoin gate: sub_4A4110(this) truthy and AIControlFlag this+0x45F4 still set.
Rejoin: status 5 -> RandomWeightedTierSelection(this), LoopWithConditionalSubCall(sel,1), VehicleClimbAdjust(0), driverStatus = 3; else driverStatus = 0.
Hold in pit: timeOfNextExit this+0x4534 = dbl_8AFEA0 + 4.0.
Terminal outputs: steering 0, brake 1.0, throttle 0.

unresolved: Read-only globals flt_59E43C..flt_59E87C and unk_7CE2F0 appear in the packet but are absent from the raw source text; they are consumed inside the called AI subsystems (racing-line / ability tuning) rather than this function directly.
Per-entry array write in the lap-time loop uses a base constant (this + 4*entry + const) that is not present in the field list; the destination was described generically.
v37/v38 reuse a single stack slot for different floats across branches (lights dt vs brake magnitude); register-aliasing ambiguity, no semantic impact.
